text:
sara_sales: HS Capital wants a short feasibility response for a 30-day on-prem air-gapped POC. Main asks: USB/hand-delivered media, signed bundles + SBOM, ability to verify with their HSM public key, delta updates over low-bandwidth links, 30-day offline activation, and emergency hotfix path. Need bullets + one-paragraph summary + any commercial constraints.
evan_se: copy. Can you mention PS estimate and anything that would block the POC?
pri_ops: quick take: doable but with constraints. Bullets:
- Packaging: We produce immutable signed release bundles (OCI-style tarballs). Full installer ~2GB-3GB depending on model artifacts. We can supply via USB or internal air-gapped repo.
- Deltas: we support intra-minor delta patches (e.g., 3.2.x -> 3.2.y). Cross-minor requires a full bundle. Delta mechanism uses binary diffs + chunked transfer; recommend enabling resumable transfers.
- Activation: Offline activator flow supported. Customer generates CSR -> hands it to us via secure transfer (SFTP/USB) -> we return a time-bound activation token. Token validity configurable (default POC window 14-30 days). Verification happens locally with no egress.
- Signing/verification: bundles signed by Redwood build key. We can embed a customer-provided public key into the local verifier so verification can be done against customer HSM-exported public keys. We do not accept customer private keys in our hosted build pipeline.
- SBOM: SPDX v2.2 SBOMs included per bundle. To guarantee SBOM stability we recommend freezing dependencies for the POC release.
- Hotfixes: emergency hotfix path available; we can push signed micro-deltas or a hotfix full bundle depending on scope. SLA for hotfix delivery requires PS sloting.
keiko_security: security caveats to call out to customer and legal:
- Key rotation & revocation: need to define rotation cadence and emergency revocation process in SOW (what if a signing key is compromised?).
- FIPS/HSM: verification against public keys exported from a FIPS 140-2 HSM is supported. If customer requires our signing to be attested by a FIPS HSM, that'll need a separate security review and PS work.
- Telemetry: nodes can be configured to fully opt out of outbound telemetry; we will provide a runbook to verify no egress.
sam_eng: ops recommendation: limit the POC to a single minor line (e.g., 3.2.x) and a constrained artifact subset (disable optional plugins) to keep bundle size small and simplify deltas. Example verification and activation commands for the runbook:
```
# verify signature locally
./rwd-verify --bundle /media/usb/release-3.2.7.tar.gz --pubkey customer-hsm-pub.pem
# create activator CSR (customer)
openssl req -new -nodes -out install.csr -keyout install.key -subj \"/CN=hs-poc\"
# activator (Redwood offline)
./rwd-activator --csr install.csr --expires 2026-05-10 > activation.token
```
build-bot: release uploaded: release-3.2.7 (sha256: d4f2...9c11) signed by rwd-build-2026 :package:
sara_sales: thanks. Two deliverables I need by EOD: 1) a one-paragraph feasibility blurb I can paste into the questionnaire/SOW, and 2) recommended default cadence for the POC + a PS hours estimate.
evan_se: draft one-paragraph: "Redwood can support a 30-day air-gapped on-prem POC by delivering signed, verifiable on-prem bundles distributed via USB or local repo, including SPDX SBOMs and a local verification utility. We support intra-minor delta updates for bandwidth-constrained environments and provide an offline activation flow based on time-bound tokens; verification runs entirely on the node with no egress required. Customer HSM-exported public keys may be imported into the verifier for local signature checks; signing operations remain within Redwood's build pipeline. Key rotation and emergency revocation procedures will be defined in the SOW."
keiko_security: small edit: add that verification against HSM-exported public keys is supported and note need for a revocation clause.
evan_se: updated: "... Customer HSM-exported public keys may be imported into the verifier for local signature checks; verification against FIPS-backed public keys is supported. Signing operations remain within Redwood's build pipeline; key rotation and emergency revocation procedures will be defined in the SOW."
pri_ops: PS estimate: 3.5 days default (2d runbook & onboarding, 1d bundle customization, 0.5d activation token ops). If customer requests BYO signing (hosting their private key in our pipeline) that's out-of-scope and will require a security review + additional PS (estimate 5-10d). Note also any requests for daily minor upgrades increase PS and bandwidth costs.
sara_sales: perfect. I'll send this to the customer. I'll include the commands and the PS estimate. If they push for BYO private signing key we'll escalate to security. Thanks team :raised_hands:
